book.name: Tayusima
book.title: Tsiyatsis tayusima anu Móysisarini Israelchichee waneero, tsiyatsis tayusirangiya

content: Ashiriya, na minootssha tsiyatsis kamanchintspa yuwaatssha tputs mangutari ngichkana anootsi

Móysissha Israelchichee tárangiya. Minumari tputs, In tputs yutaritcha, atinaari, itaru nda tsimbun, nduntaati ashiru tuchip anoo k'kuz nda waanand átu, an tsiyatsis ngichiztanda. Itaru, tputs tsimbun, nduntaati tuchip k'kuz waanand átu, zurkutanicha atini tákchu an k'kuz wapta tsiyatkiya.
Ashiriya, tputs waanariya tayutaritamapan mangutari ngicheeru, tputsee nambku, yuwamand mantsir patatarangu anumanda atinaariya ashiru,
Apanllip pang' naangtsa, watam apanllpantam urkari, misha yaktatam urkari anush shaniykanawa. Kurakaw ndaturi shitungaru wandari tarawaztakuritssin,
anush kuskachus, yakatsha urkar anoo ichingaru wanasiriri mashchiya. Wandaya kurakush nabati átu, tputsee yushindarangu, mangutari arangeem ngicheeru, nda tatsamooru tsiyatsis wapta átu,
ashiriya anoo tputsee putayarusin wanichinllinaya. Amuyaatsirisha tputsee kiyung yachamaam chinarangu ambitam sheersin kasachinllinaya. Ashkatssin, izuuru an ngichizipan tputs kuk pastachshaparee.
Ashiriya amb ashkus, tputs ichingarusin yasakchusin, kizpurparee punichinllinaya. Ndushapari ngichzee mangutari arangeem tsiyatchinllinaya.

Chakaatsimasaja tputs wanimaam taariya anoo kaapa natstayarus, naynirintspa; izuuru tatsamooru waneerus ksangtsa. Wambaz tputs tputsee pachakinaariya, siysa pachayaritamtis ksangtsa. Wambaz tputs waratkinaariya, wachoo tsseekchu, siysa wachoo tsseeyaritamtis ksangtsa. Wapaz tputs nasishish tuzimku, naseetsish kurumbtakchu, siysa anoo wanasseetstam kuwayaritamtis ksangtsa.

Waanariya kuweetsis tputs chpakinaariya, siysa uwee chpayaritamtis kasangtsa. Waanariya siyaa tputs k'tseetsis chpakinaariya, siysat utsee chpayaritamtis ksangtsa, Móysis tárangiya. Ashiriya, na kamaneena yuwaa tputs mangutari ngichkana anoo Apanll kamachtamarini itsinsampatari kamanku anootsi.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Matiwa 18.6, misha 2 Koríndshucheema 13.1 tayusima kamankiya.
